name: Los Cerritos Center
summary: Spacious shopping center offers a range of brand-name retailers, plus well-known chain restaurants.
description: Los Cerritos Center is a premier shopping destination in Cerritos, California, offering an extensive mix of retail stores, dining options, and entertainment including a movie theater. With extended hours until 10 PM, the center provides a convenient and comprehensive shopping experience for the entire family with events, seasonal attractions like Santa Photos, and a diverse array of retail and food choices.
demographics: Los Cerritos Center serves a diverse, middle-class trade area in Southeast Los Angeles County, drawing visitors from Cerritos, Lakewood, Norwalk, and surrounding communities. The primary market consists of families with children, Asian-American households (particularly Filipino, Chinese, and Korean), and Hispanic households, with median household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $90,000. Shoppers typically seek value-oriented retailers and mainstream brands, with strong attendance during weekends and holidays, reflecting the center's role as a regional gathering place for multi-generational family shopping trips.
